description: This Java class provides services for integrating with CyberSource payment gateway, including methods for authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit transactions, along with configuration handling and request/response processing.

classes.name: IcsPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling payment transactions with CyberSource, including authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit operations, along with configuration management and response processing.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization with CyberSource, builds request, transmits, and processes response.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Stub method returning success, placeholder for re-authorization logic.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized payment, builds request, transmits, and processes response.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a previously authorized transaction, builds request, transmits, and processes response.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured payment, builds request, transmits, and processes response.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Credits a payment, builds request, transmits, and processes response.

methods.name: buildCsProperties
methods.description: Constructs configuration properties for CyberSource client based on payment gateway settings.

methods.name: buildAuthRequest
methods.description: Creates request map for authorization, including billing info and item details.

methods.name: buildCaptureRequest
methods.description: Creates request map for capture transaction, including reference ID and merchant info.

methods.name: buildReleaseRequest
methods.description: Creates request map for releasing (voiding) a transaction.

methods.name: buildRefundRequest
methods.description: Creates request map for refund, including reference ID and amount.

methods.name: buildCreditRequest
methods.description: Creates request map for credit operation, including billing info and amount.

methods.name: appendAvsRules
methods.description: Adds AVS decline codes and rules to request based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: appendFullBillingInfo
methods.description: Adds billing, shipping, and credit card info to request from context.

methods.name: appendItemLineInfo
methods.description: Adds line item details to request, including product info and quantities.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats BigDecimal amount to string with proper scale and rounding.

methods.name: processAuthResult
methods.description: Processes authorization reply, sets result flags and codes.

methods.name: processCaptureResult
methods.description: Processes capture reply, sets result flags and amounts.

methods.name: processReleaseResult
methods.description: Processes release reply, sets result flags and amounts.

methods.name: processRefundResult
methods.description: Processes refund reply, sets result flags and amounts.

methods.name: processCreditResult
methods.description: Processes credit reply, sets result flags and amounts.

methods.name: getDecision
methods.description: Extracts decision string from reply and logs info if not accepted.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value for CyberSource from database or properties.
